# sharepoint_navigation_node (Resource)

Manages a node in a SharePoint site's quick launch or top navigation bar using the M365 CLI (m365 spo navigation node add / get / set / remove).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sharepoint_navigation_node" "policies" {
  web_url  = "https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/hr"
  location = "QuickLaunch"
  title    = "Policies"
  url      = "/sites/hr/Policies"
}

resource "sharepoint_navigation_node" "intranet" {
  web_url            = "https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/hr"
  location           = "TopNavigationBar"
  title              = "Contoso Intranet"
  url                = "https://intranet.contoso.com"
  is_external        = true
  open_in_new_window = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) Navigation tree this node belongs to: QuickLaunch or TopNavigationBar. Required even when parent_node_id is set (to nest under an existing node), because removing a node always requires knowing which tree it lives in.
- `title` (String) Display title of the navigation node.
- `web_url` (String) Absolute URL of the site whose navigation should be modified.

### Optional

- `audience_ids` (Set of String) Microsoft 365 group IDs used for audience targeting of this node (max 10).
- `is_external` (Boolean) Whether the node points to an external URL.
- `open_in_new_window` (Boolean) Whether the link opens in a new window.
- `parent_node_id` (String) ID of an existing node to nest this node below. When set, this node is created under that node instead of directly under location.
- `url` (String) URL the node links to. Leave unset to create a linkless label.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric ID assigned to the node by SharePoint.
